name: Ultravox
positioning: Ultravox is a developer platform for real-time voice agents built on its own open-weight speech-native model; the company states it has been acquired by Inworld.

pricing.model: Per-minute usage with a free allowance, optional $100/month Pro plan that removes concurrency caps, and custom Enterprise.
pricing.headline: $0.05 per minute (TTS included) after 30 free minutes, up to 5 concurrent calls on pay-as-you-go; SIP minutes at 0.5 cents.
planNotes: Pay as you go: $0 per month, 30 free minutes, $0.05/min, 5 concurrent calls, no surge pricing.
Pro: $100/month (the page marks prices as annual rate), no hard concurrency cap, outbound call scheduler, 5 custom voices, 20 RAG corpora.
Enterprise: custom, priority SLA and org support.
SIP: 0.5 cents/min on pay-as-you-go and 0.48 cents/min on Pro.
The $0.05/min rate appears on both the home page and the pricing page; the pricing page shows the plan and SIP detail.
pricing.freeTrial: First 30 minutes free, plus unlimited playground calls.
whatIsExtra: Threads (text) usage at $2.00 per 1M uncached input tokens and $15.00 per 1M output tokens
Custom voice clones beyond plan allowance

strengths.claim: Speech-native model that takes audio directly rather than transcribing first, with an open-weight release on Hugging Face.
Simple, all-in published rate of $0.05/min including TTS, with no surge pricing stated.
Native telephony integrations for Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo and Exotel, plus a SIP integration for existing phone systems.
Supports 26 spoken languages and features such as tools, RAG, call stages, voice cloning and webhooks.
Integrations with LiveKit, Pipecat, Voximplant and jambonz for custom stacks.

limitations.claim: Pay-as-you-go is capped at 5 concurrent calls; removing the cap requires the $100/month Pro plan.
The site states the company has been acquired by Inworld, so roadmap and branding may change.
Pricing page marks prices as an annual rate, so month-to-month cost for Pro may differ.

compliance.note: The site links a Trust page hosted on a third-party trust portal, which could not be read (bot check). No HIPAA, SOC 2 or GDPR statement was visible on the pricing page, home page or docs read.

telephony.providedNumbers: No Ultravox-provided phone numbers were found on the pages read; the platform connects to your Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo or Exotel account or an existing SIP setup.

stepsToLeave: List and fetch agent definitions with the List Agents and Get Agent API endpoints.
Conversation history (audio recordings and transcripts) is available through the calls messages API.
Telephony accounts you connected (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel) remain with those providers; repointing numbers is done there.

bestFor: Developers who want a low-latency, speech-native voice model with a simple per-minute price and who already have, or want to choose, their own telephony provider.
unknowns: HIPAA, SOC 2 and GDPR status (Trust page not readable).
Terms and timing of the Inworld acquisition and any pricing change; only the banner notice was read.
Whether the Pro price is $100 month-to-month or only on annual billing.
